claim: The credibility record and the method documents still describe the project as of 2026-10-26. On the points that matter they overstate what was shown or contradict the PI's 2026-10-27 decisions; F-0018 (round 2) was not acted on. (1) VERIFICATION.md is titled 'GPU explicit solver' and dated 2026-10-26. It lists gates 1, 1b and 1c as PASS, all run on the explicit / dynamic-relaxation solver that is no longer the production solver. It omits gate 1d. It shows gate 2 as 'running', while the only result is a flexion pass with zero facet force (F-0023). A reader would conclude the production solver passed 3 gates; it has passed none with contact or sliding. (2) METHODS_COMPARISON.md:28 still says 'M3 <= mu -> safe for sure; M2 > mu -> slips for sure'. Both halves are false on present evidence: M3 under-estimates by 1.4-2.8x when the glue is in tension (F-0021) and drops out-of-plane shear (F-0011), so 'safe for sure' is unsafe; whole-face sliding ignores walking (F-0024). (3) It still recommends 'Own GPU explicit solver (TLED)' with 'no convergence failure' (:42-46), although the PI chose GPU Newton (DECISIONS.md:31). Gate 4 still compares slip with FEBio (:56), although the PI made 'the law' the reference (DECISIONS.md:96). Gate 5 (kinetic energy) does not apply to a static Newton solver. :31 / :58 still define expulsion as cage-centre translation. (4) PLAN.md:35 S9 still says 'cage-centre translation <= 1 mm' while DECISIONS.md:110-117 replaced it with rigid-body radial migration (F-0022). The safety guard, the verifier and a future designer reading PLAN get the old rule. (5) ISSUES.md I-001 says 'physio runs to be redone' and I-002 lists 'friction limit with twist ... 0.37 / 0.57 / ~2' from INVALID runs as open, although the reruns were analysed in round 2 (F-0012).
evidence: results/gpufe_verify/VERIFICATION.md lines 1 ('GPU explicit solver'), table header 'Result (2026-10-26)', 1b row '275-1225 DR iterations', gate 2 'running'; git log -- results/gpufe_verify/VERIFICATION.md -> only 30e8f95 (split). gpufe/gate1b_equilibrium.py:1 (dynamic relaxation). METHODS_COMPARISON.md:28, :42, :44-46, :56-58 (quoted); git log -- docs/METHODS_COMPARISON.md -> only 30e8f95. PLAN.md:35. ISSUES.md:5-6. Numbers for (2): work/agents/redteam/r0003_tension_result.json (F-0021).
how_to_reproduce: git log --oneline -- results/gpufe_verify/VERIFICATION.md docs/METHODS_COMPARISON.md docs/ISSUES.md; read the cited lines; compare with docs/DECISIONS.md:92-117.

fix_options.option: Verifier (owner of gates) rewrites VERIFICATION.md for the Newton solver: one row per gate with solver, code hash, date, what it exercises (stick / slip / tied / facet contact) and PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN; old explicit-solver passes moved to a 'superseded' section.

Integrator: METHODS_COMPARISON.md section A: delete 'safe for sure / slips for sure', add the tension and curved-face caveats; section B: replace with the decided Newton design and the law-based friction reference; PLAN.md S9 updated to the PI definition plus the open checks of F-0022; ISSUES.md refreshed every round.
Add a 'stale document' check to the round runner: any doc older than the latest DECISIONS.md entry that it references is flagged in the digest.

summary_zh: 驗證紀錄和方法比較文件還停留在 10 月 26 日的版本，而且說得比實際證明的多，第二輪紅隊的同類發現（F-0018）沒有被處理。一、驗證紀錄的標題仍是「GPU 顯式求解器」，列出的三道「通過」關卡都是用已經不再使用的舊求解器跑的；新的牛頓法求解器在有接觸或滑動的情況下一道關卡都沒通過，讀者卻會以為已經通過三道。二、方法比較文件仍寫著「摩擦極限值小於摩擦係數就一定安全」，但紅隊已證明這個值會被低估 1.4 到 2.8 倍（F-0021），所以「一定安全」其實不安全。三、文件仍推薦 PI 沒有採用的顯式求解器，第四關仍拿 FEBio 當摩擦參考（PI 已改為物理定律），第五關的動能檢查不適用於牛頓法。四、計畫文件的滑出規則仍是舊的「cage 中心位移」，與 PI 10 月 27 日的新定義不一致。五、給 PI 的待辦清單仍列著已作廢的舊數字。建議：由驗證者重寫驗證紀錄（每道關卡註明用哪個求解器、哪個程式版本、測到什麼）；更新方法比較與計畫文件；每輪自動標出過時的文件。
